text: 1. Have good conduct, be in good health, and be willing to abide by relevant Chinese laws and regulations as well as the school's rules and regulations. Generally, the age range is 18 to 30 years old (those under 18 years old must provide relevant legal documents from their legal guardians in China). Foreign citizens who have obtained an equivalent educational qualification to that of a Chinese high school graduate. 2. Language Requirements: 2.1 Chinese-language-taught programs: New HSK Level 4 score of 180 or above 2.2 For English-taught programs, the following conditions must be met at least by one of them: 1) Native language is English 2) The official language is English. 3) High school or university education is in English. 4) TOEFL: 80 or a score of B2 or above in the TOEFL online test 5) IELTS: 5.5 6) Other certificates of English proficiency that meet the requirements 2.3 Requirements for Chinese Proficiency upon Graduation: 1) Chinese language instruction: HSK Level 5 or above 2) English instruction: HSK 4 level or above 3. According to Article 5 of the Nationality Law of the People's Republic of China, if both or one of the parents is a Chinese citizen and has settled in a foreign country, and the individual acquires foreign nationality at the time of birth, they do not have Chinese nationality. Since 2021, those who apply to enter our university for undergraduate studies as international students must, in addition to meeting other school's application requirements, also hold a valid foreign passport or nationality certificate for 4 years (inclusive) or more, and have a record of actual residence in a foreign country for 2 years or more within the last 4 years (as of the April 30th of the year of admission). (Nine months of actual residence in a foreign country can be counted as one year, based on the entry and exit stamps.)
